headline: Taiwan stocks close weekly higher by 995 points; listed companies' total market value breaks above NT$154 trillion | Securities
summary: Taiwan's benchmark index closed Friday at 47,180.75, up 2.16% for the week. Total market value of listed companies rose to NT$154.3 trillion, about NT$3.3 trillion higher than last week.
why: The Taiwan Stock Exchange benchmark tracks the island's largest listed companies, including major semiconductor makers that carry heavy weight in global tech supply chains.
